changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Question') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Question]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [SurveyID] [int] NOT NULL, [Comment] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Question_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Question] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Question_Survey') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Question] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Question_Survey] FOREIGN KEY([SurveyID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Survey] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Question] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Question_Survey] END
